messages:
maria: Morning team We need a tight benchmark narrative for launch. Focus: make latency vs cost intuitive for three slices (consumer chat, search, rerank). What 2-3 visuals land fastest and what routing + CTA do we pair with each?
dan: Bubble chart (latency vs cost, bubble=size QPS) + waterfall for cost breakdown. Show p50 and p95. Keep one example trace (timeline) to show how history length affects latency.
liz: Design constraints: 3 visuals max. No tiny text. Annotate SLA lines (200ms, 500ms, 1500ms). Call out measurement conditions (QPS, sequence length). I'll do the visual once we lock the CSV. :art:
sam: Webinar idea: 20m bench methodology + 15m demo (autoscale + routing) + 10m Q&A. I can demo the autoscale replay. Need a short enterprise CTA and a microcopy for quick-start.
ops-bot: benchmark upload: s3://redwood-run-bench/2025-07-01/latency-econ-v3.csv :link:
dan: here's a tiny sample to use as placeholder (use for axis labels):
```
model,workload,latency_p50_ms,latency_p95_ms,cost_per_1k_tokens_usd,avg_history_len
fast-lite,consumer_chat,95,240,0.55,32
balanced,search,320,720,0.29,128
quant-slim,rerank,180,420,0.10,64
```
liz: +1 on showing avg_history_len in tooltip. Also add an inset for autoscale cost per token vs QPS so enterprises see predictable unit economics.
maria: Inbound routing plan: landing page with two flows -> quick-start (email + use-case) -> self-serve growth, enterprise intake (company, monthly_tokens_est, SLA_need) -> sales. GA/webhook rules: `if monthly_tokens_est > 100000000 OR SLA_need == "<500ms" -> tag:enterprise`
sam: Suggested microcopy for quick-start CTA: "Try a 5-minute demo: see latency & cost for your workload." Enterprise CTA: "Talk to our infra team about dedicated capacity."
dan: Sales FYI: if we put a <200ms claim for consumer chat, add a footnote: measured at 95th under steady state 5-20 QPS, no long histories. Liz, can you design an asterisk panel?
liz: Yep. I'll include a small methodology card: bullets for test harness (seq lengths, batch sizes, warm caches).
maria: Action items: 1) dan confirm full CSV + p50/p95 columns by Tues EOD, 2) liz mock visuals + methodology card by Thurs noon, 3) sam prep demo replay + webinar outline, 4) ops-bot note: link is uploaded. Reconvene Fri 9am to review assets. Thanks! :sparkles:
